description: pull-sync found live source under /vessels/activity-api collapsed to a fraction of its git content (content drift (live f01277cbd4 != clone 9dfebd7230)) while the unit was still active. A write tool truncated running vessel source; the vessel kept serving from its in-memory module, so nothing else noticed. Re-mirrored from the clone. Ops are applied against RUNTIME_ROOT (live source) rather than a scratch copy — that is the class to close.
